modePolicy.planMode: Validate contracts, topology, gates, and planned evidence without provider mutation.
modePolicy.executeMode: Run live provider commands, runtime drills, telemetry checks, load tests, rollback checks, and record fresh operations evidence.
executeRequires: Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry health URLs
Vercel deployment credentials when app deployment is requested
k6, locust, gatling, terraform, psql, and pnpm
forbidden: recording passed failover evidence without observed RTO/RPO
recording passed load evidence without measured latency/error metrics
recording passed chaos evidence without recovery observation
recording live certification from documentation alone

requiredStages.name: typescript
requiredStages.script: pnpm run validate:typescript && pnpm run typecheck

requiredStages.name: tests
requiredStages.script: pnpm run test && pnpm run validate:tests
requiredStages.evidence: node test and critical test proof output

requiredStages.name: observability
requiredStages.evidence: dashboard, alert, and collector validation output

requiredStages.name: rollback
requiredStages.evidence: rollback command path and Cloudflare rollback response in execute mode

requiredStages.name: chaos
requiredStages.evidence: chaos tests plus operations evidence in execute mode

requiredStages.name: load
requiredStages.evidence: k6, Locust, and Gatling results in execute mode
